@oliviertassinari Can you tell us where the base screenshots are taken from? Master? Develop? Would be nice to some documentation about the whole architecture :)

@bobylito The base screenshots is computed from the git history. We use the **forking commit** between the pull-request commit and the pull-request target commit. Does that make sense?
It's the same logic as: https://percy.io/docs/learn/baseline-picking-logic#pull-requests
We have a load of unit-tests for it. I can link you them if you want.

I agree, we need to document it!
@oliviertassinari So if the branch is updated (by a merge of develop in our case), does it change the forking commit?

> So if the branch is updated (by a merge of develop in our case), does it change the forking commit?

@bobylito No. You need to rebase your branch on this new commit.
